title: Don’t send the slides
body:
The deck is a view.
The prim is the file.
Open it here. Send the file, not a PPTX.

title: One store
body:
Humans write the same records.
Agents write the same records.
No reconstruction from an export.

title: Cite, don’t copy
body:
The editor talks.
The pack stays put.
Chat still points this file.

title: Send the prim
body:
Drop this file on the chat.
The surface opens.
The slides are still here.
